# Manan Suri

> Manan Suri is a Computer Science PhD student at the University of Maryland, College Park (GAMMA Lab, advised by Dinesh Manocha). He works on LLM agents: how agents hold and use context, attribution methods that make agent outputs trustworthy, parametric memory that distills multimodal context into LoRA adapters, and the training data and benchmarks agents need. Not to be confused with Manan Suri, professor at IIT Delhi.

Site: https://manansuri.com
Contact: see https://manansuri.com/ (email, X @mananifesto, GitHub MananSuri27)
Identifiers: ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5089-2658 · Google Scholar https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=KbVluf4AAAAJ · Semantic Scholar https://www.semanticscholar.org/author/145282060
